lament.en: The poem is a lament for a town changed by time.
lament.zh: 這首詩是對一座隨時間改變的城鎮所作的哀歌。

landing.en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the strong wind.
landing.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機仍平穩降落。

lawnmower.en: The old lawnmower was replaced with a quieter electric model.
lawnmower.zh: 舊割草機被一台更安靜的電動機型取代。

leakage.en: The engineer checked the pipe for signs of water leakage.
leakage.zh: 工程師檢查管線是否有漏水跡象。

legally.en: The organization is legally required to keep accurate financial records.
legally.zh: 該組織依法必須保存正確的財務紀錄。

lesser.en: The group chose the lesser problem to solve first.
lesser.zh: 小組先選擇處理較小的問題。

lifeboat.en: The museum displays an old lifeboat from a historic passenger ship.
lifeboat.zh: 博物館展示一艘來自歷史客輪的舊救生艇。

lightweight.en: This lightweight backpack is convenient for short school trips.
lightweight.zh: 這個輕量背包很適合短程校外活動。

liking.en: She developed a liking for astronomy after visiting the observatory.
liking.zh: 參觀天文台後，她開始喜歡上天文學。

limited.en: The library has limited seating during the examination period.
limited.zh: 考試期間圖書館座位有限。

lingering.en: A lingering question remained after the class discussion ended.
lingering.zh: 課堂討論結束後，仍留下一個未解的問題。

linguist.en: The linguist studies how young people use new expressions online.
linguist.zh: 這位語言學家研究年輕人如何在網路上使用新表達。

linguistics.en: She became interested in linguistics through her English classes.
linguistics.zh: 她透過英文課開始對語言學產生興趣。

liquidation.en: The article explains why liquidation may occur when a business closes.
liquidation.zh: 文章說明企業結束營業時為何可能進行清算。

livelihood.en: Fishing provides a livelihood for many families in the village.
livelihood.zh: 捕魚為村裡許多家庭提供生計。

living.en: The documentary compares living conditions in several different cities.
living.zh: 紀錄片比較幾座不同城市的生活條件。

locomotive.en: The restored locomotive is now displayed beside the old station.
locomotive.zh: 修復後的火車頭現在展示在舊車站旁。

loft.en: The artist turned the loft into a bright studio.
loft.zh: 藝術家把閣樓改造成明亮的工作室。

loom.en: Dark clouds began to loom over the mountains before sunset.
loom.zh: 日落前，烏雲開始籠罩山區。

loosely.en: The papers were loosely arranged in a folder on the desk.
loosely.zh: 文件鬆散地放在桌上的資料夾裡。

lorry.en: A large lorry delivered supplies to the construction site.
lorry.zh: 一輛大型卡車把物資送到工地。

lovable.en: The animated character is lovable because of its curious personality.
lovable.zh: 這個動畫角色因為好奇的個性而很討人喜歡。

loving.en: The story portrays a loving family that supports one another.
loving.zh: 故事描寫一個彼此支持、充滿關愛的家庭。

lubricant.en: The maintenance guide explains that lubricant reduces friction in machines.
lubricant.zh: 維修指南說明潤滑劑能降低機械中的摩擦。

luminous.en: The luminous display remained visible even in the dark room.
luminous.zh: 發光顯示器即使在黑暗房間裡仍清楚可見。

luncheon.en: The school hosted a luncheon for visiting teachers and students.
luncheon.zh: 學校為來訪的師生舉辦午餐會。

lyric.en: The teacher asked us to analyze one lyric from the original poem.
lyric.zh: 老師要我們分析原詩中的一句詩句。

manageable.en: Breaking the assignment into parts made the workload more manageable.
manageable.zh: 把作業拆成幾部分後，工作量變得更容易處理。

mandarin.en: The fruit stand sells mandarin oranges during the winter season.
mandarin.zh: 水果攤在冬季販售橘子。

manifestation.en: The sudden color change was a manifestation of the chemical reaction.
manifestation.zh: 突然的顏色變化是化學反應的一種表現。

manifesto.en: The class read a historical manifesto and discussed its main ideas.
manifesto.zh: 班上閱讀一份歷史宣言並討論其中主要觀點。

manners.en: Good manners help group discussions stay respectful and productive.
manners.zh: 良好禮貌有助於讓小組討論保持尊重且有效率。

manpower.en: The project required more manpower during the final preparation stage.
manpower.zh: 專題在最後準備階段需要更多人力。

mare.en: The mare walked calmly beside her young foal.
mare.zh: 母馬平靜地走在小馬旁邊。

mars.en: The astronomy club discussed what scientists have learned about mars.
mars.zh: 天文社討論科學家目前對火星的了解。

ointment.en: The museum display included an old jar labeled ointment.
ointment.zh: 博物館展示中有一個標示為藥膏的舊罐子。

oust.en: The board voted to oust the chairperson after a formal review.
oust.zh: 董事會在正式審查後投票撤換主席。

out-of-date.en: The teacher replaced an out-of-date map with a newer version.
out-of-date.zh: 老師用新版地圖取代了過時的地圖。

overeat.en: The health lesson explains why people may overeat when distracted.
overeat.zh: 健康課說明人們在分心時為何可能吃得過量。

panacea.en: The article warns that technology is not a panacea for every problem.
panacea.zh: 文章提醒科技並不是解決所有問題的萬靈丹。
